ucs.title: [LLM] Scattered Spider (Octo Tempest / UNC3944) multi-RMM tooling cluster install
ucs.description: Hunts for the actor's signature pattern of layering 2+ legitimate Remote Monitoring & Management tools (AnyDesk, ScreenConnect, Splashtop, Pulseway, Teleport-style tunnels like ngrok/chisel/rsocx) on the same host within one hour of help-desk-vishing or AiTM-based initial access. Scattered Spider is documented by Microsoft (Octo Tempest), Mandiant (UNC3944) and CrowdStrike (Scattered Spider) as the e-crime crew that prefers signed commercial RMMs over custom implants because they survive AV/EDR allowlists.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen dc(Processes.process_name) as distinct_rmms values(Processes.process_name) as rmm_binaries values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("anydesk.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","connectwisecontrol.client.exe","splashtop.exe","splashtopstreamer.exe","teamviewer.exe","teamviewer_service.exe","pulseway.exe","rustdesk.exe","ateraagent.exe","tacticalagent.exe","tacticalrmm.exe","ngrok.exe","chisel.exe","rsocx.exe","fleetdeck.exe","level.exe","msp360.exe","syncro.exe","meshagent.exe") by host Processes.user _time span=1h | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where distinct_rmms >= 2 AND NOT match(user,"\$$") | sort - first_seen
ucs.kql:
let RMMNames = dynamic(["anydesk.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","connectwisecontrol.client.exe","splashtop.exe","splashtopstreamer.exe","teamviewer.exe","teamviewer_service.exe","pulseway.exe","rustdesk.exe","ateraagent.exe","tacticalagent.exe","tacticalrmm.exe","ngrok.exe","chisel.exe","rsocx.exe","fleetdeck.exe","level.exe","msp360.exe","syncro.exe","meshagent.exe"]);
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let WindowMinutes = 60m;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
| where FileName in~ (RMMNames)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| summarize DistinctRMMs = dcount(FileName),
            RMMList = make_set(FileName, 16),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LatestSeen = max(Timestamp),
            SampleCmd = any(ProcessCommandLine),
            SampleParent = any(InitiatingProcessFileName)
            by DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, WindowMinutes)
| where DistinctRMMs >= 2     // 2+ distinct RMM agents in same hour = Octo Tempest signature
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let RMMNames = dynamic(["anydesk.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","connectwisecontrol.client.exe","splashtop.exe","splashtopstreamer.exe","teamviewer.exe","teamviewer_service.exe","pulseway.exe","rustdesk.exe","ateraagent.exe","tacticalagent.exe","tacticalrmm.exe","ngrok.exe","chisel.exe","rsocx.exe","fleetdeck.exe","level.exe","msp360.exe","syncro.exe","meshagent.exe"]);
let WindowMinutes = 60m;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend RMMBinary = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where RMMBinary in (RMMNames)
| where TargetUserName !endswith "$"
| where TargetUserName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| summarize DistinctRMMs = dcount(RMMBinary),
            RMMList = make_set(RMMBinary, 16),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LatestSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
            SampleCmd = any(CommandLine),
            SampleParent = any(ParentProcessName)
            by Computer, TargetUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, WindowMinutes)
| where DistinctRMMs >= 2     // 2+ distinct RMM agents in same hour = Octo Tempest signature
| order by FirstSeen desc

ucs.title: [LLM] Scattered Spider Entra ID federated-domain trust backdoor (T1484.002 Golden SAML setup)
ucs.description: Detects modification of Microsoft Entra ID domain authentication / federation trust settings — the actor converts a managed domain to federated, points it at an attacker-controlled IdP, and mints arbitrary SAML tokens for any user in the tenant. Microsoft's Octo Tempest blog specifically calls this out as the crew's hallmark persistence move after compromising a Global Admin via help-desk vishing.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen values(All_Changes.src) as src_ips values(All_Changes.user) as initiators values(All_Changes.object) as target_domains values(All_Changes.command) as operations from datamodel=Change.All_Changes where All_Changes.vendor_product="Office 365" AND All_Changes.object_category="domain" AND All_Changes.command IN ("Set domain authentication.","Set federation settings on domain.","Add unverified domain.","Set DirSyncEnabled flag.","Update domain.") by All_Changes.object All_Changes.user | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Changes)` | sort - first_seen
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
CloudAppEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where Application == "Office 365"
| where ActionType in~ (
    "Set domain authentication.",
    "Set federation settings on domain.",
    "Add unverified domain.",
    "Set DirSyncEnabled flag.",
    "Update domain."
  )
| extend TargetDomain = tostring(parse_json(tostring(ActivityObjects))[0].Name)
| extend RawJson = tostring(RawEventData)
| project Timestamp, ActionType, AccountDisplayName, AccountObjectId,
          IPAddress, CountryCode, City, UserAgent,
          TargetDomain, ActivityObjects, RawJson
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where OperationName in~ (
    "Set domain authentication",
    "Set federation settings on domain",
    "Add unverified domain",
    "Set DirSyncEnabled flag",
    "Update domain"
  )
| extend Initiator = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName),
         InitiatorIp = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.ipAddress),
         AppInitiator = tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName),
         TargetDomain = tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName),
         OldFederationValue = tostring(TargetResources[0].modifiedProperties[0].oldValue),
         NewFederationValue = tostring(TargetResources[0].modifiedProperties[0].newValue)
| project TimeGenerated, OperationName, Result, Initiator, InitiatorIp,
          AppInitiator, TargetDomain, OldFederationValue, NewFederationValue,
          AdditionalDetails
| order by TimeGenerated desc
